page.layout: One block of running text, one column, full width. Above it the running head and page number at the top right. Below the text the signature and catchword. The left edge strip holds fragments from the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The faint marks at the right edge are show-through or stains.

main_text.p: mortalem, omnia illa incommoda, in quæ à natura ferimur præcipites: carnê peccatricem, & membra nostra mortificemus in carne: à studiis carnis, quàm diligentissimè fieri potest, abscedamus: Deum quæramus in Ecclesia: Ecclesiam in Deo, nos & fratres nostros in Deo & Ecclesia simul recognoscamus, & pacem cum omnibus à Deo constitutam colamus constantissimè, fugientem persequamur, oppugnatam propugnemus, amissam quæramus, inuentam teneamus, & obtinentes optimè seruemus in Deo, in Ecclesia, in nobis, & inter nos religiosissimè, expectantes optatissimum illum aduentum Domini & Seruatoris nostri Iesu Christi: qui pacè hîc in se partam, & in nobis inchoatam, illîc in cælis consummaturus est perfecta & æterna consummatione. Amen.

page.notes: The first word of the page continues a sentence from the previous page. The tilde over "carnê" and "pacè" and the circumflex over "hîc" and "illîc" are printed as shown but are faint on the scan. The catchword "PARS" and the signature "P 4" are read from the foot of the page. The spelling is kept as printed, including the long s in the Latin, which is written as plain s.
